subject: Life Skills

source.subtopic: Day and night sandwich; things seen in the sky by day and by night

show.line: In the day we see the sun. At night we see the moon and stars!

rounds.prompt: What do we see in the sky at night?
What gives us light in the day?
What do you do at night?
Which animal is awake at night?

rounds.story: The sun goes down. The sky gets dark. Stars come out. Is it day or night?

hints: Is the sky light or dark?
The sun is for day. The moon and stars are for night.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I see the night sky.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: I see the sun shining at night!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! At night we see the moon and stars.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Night has the moon and stars!

parent_line: Can name things seen in the day sky and the night sky.
